questions.prompt: Constantinople was renamed what in the twentieth century?
questions.fact: The new name was made official in 1930, though it had been in colloquial use for centuries before that.

questions.prompt: Which class of drug is ineffective against viral infections?
questions.fact: They target structures such as bacterial cell walls, which viruses do not possess.

questions.prompt: In fencing, which weapon allows the entire body as a valid target?
questions.fact: It descends from the duelling sword, where any hit counted, and it has no right-of-way rule.

questions.prompt: Which singer and pianist recorded Mississippi Goddam in 1964?
questions.fact: She trained as a classical pianist and always described being denied a conservatory place as a formative injustice.

questions.prompt: Which line of latitude marks the northern limit of the tropics?
questions.fact: Its exact latitude drifts slightly each year as the Earth's axial tilt slowly changes.

questions.prompt: Which author created the character Raskolnikov?
questions.fact: He wrote much of his later work at speed to pay gambling debts, dictating to a stenographer he later married.
